description: Get full compliance rules evaluation for a company: Nasdaq/NYSE deficiency detection, bid price tracking, and delinquent filing detection, combining SEC filing data, market data and exchange rules. Rules cover bid price, equity, reverse-split limit, market value of publicly held shares, publicly held shares, holders, timely periodic filings, annual meeting and audit committee, per exchange tier. Standards that could not be judged from any measurement are listed in `notEvaluated`: they are neither passing nor failing. Neither a `notEvaluated` standard nor the absence of a deficiency notice is evidence of compliance.
name: get_compliance
title: Get Compliance Evaluation
